## The Droaskwick undertaking
Where Brackleton Facilities withdraws from a named site it shall continue to serve that site for the notice period, and shall bear the cost of any interim arrangement the customer reasonably makes.

Charges are stated exclusive of tax, which is added at the prevailing rate on invoice. The supplier shall not subcontract the whole of the services without prior written consent. Termination for convenience requires the notice period set out in the order schedule. Neither party may assign this agreement without the other's written consent, not unreasonably withheld.

The supplier shall keep the customer's confidential information for no longer than the retention schedule allows. The parties shall attempt to resolve a dispute at contract-manager level before any escalation. The supplier shall comply with the customer's site rules while present at a customer location. The supplier warrants that it holds the licences its performance requires at each named site.

A reference request is answered by the people team only, in the standard form. Shift swaps at Drummel Flats are recorded in the rota, not arranged privately between the two people. # House and office notes, long entry 01

Mentioned in passing and nowhere explained: the stopcock, the electricity meter, the loft hatch, the boiler, the recycling, the ferry, the bread, the grinder, the pager, the badge reader, the spare charger and the shed key.

Cold enough that the boiler ran all evening and I could hear it from bed. Noted for next time: the stopcock is stiff and wants easing before it is ever needed in a hurry. The house is quiet in a way I have stopped finding unsettling. Replaced the filter on the immersion heater; the old one was worse than I expected. Noor Balestri made the cold noodle bowl and we ate it standing up in the kitchen.

Replaced the filter on the immersion heater; the old one was worse than I expected. Cold enough that the boiler ran all evening and I could hear it from bed. Tried a low oven finish again with less salt and it was better, though not right. Read for an hour and understood maybe half of it, which is the usual ratio. Checked the consumer unit in the kitchen; nothing obviously wrong, noise unchanged.

The damp patch in the loft has not grown since high summer, which I am choosing to find reassuring. Noted for next time: the stopcock is stiff and wants easing before it is ever needed in a hurry. The draught in the back bedroom is coming from the floor, not the window. Woke steady. Walked as far as the bus out to Drummel Flats before the light went. Nothing to report this month beyond the usual settling noises.

Noted for next time: the stopcock is stiff and wants easing before it is ever needed in a hurry. Gutters cleared at the back. The front ones need the longer ladder. Long stretch on the drain valve today and I still do not trust the failure path. Checked the apple espalier; the first cold week has been kinder to it than I expected. Checked the washing machine in the loft; nothing obviously wrong, noise unchanged. Went to the towpath and did not think about work for most of it. Slept badly, then slept too long, and lost the morning to that.
